items.title: Young Snooky — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: "Thad and Mel formed that band and they asked me, ―Snooky would you come play with this band?‖ and I said, ―Sure Thad, you know I‘m going to play with that band.‖"

ctx.x: No problems, see, Thad and Mel was at the studio at CBS I think it was. Was it CBS?
